summary: Iter 216h68 — Silent JWT refresh + session-expired banner testing. Found and FIXED critical bug: AppRoutes.js was importing GymAxisLoginPage instead of LoginRedirectPage, causing ?next= parameter to be ignored. After fix, all 7 tests passed: (1) Authenticated user visiting /login?next=/pulse redirects to /pulse, (2) Unauthenticated user logging in via /login?next=/pulse redirects to /pulse, (3) Session-expired banner appears with correct text and CTAs, (4) Dismiss button hides banner without navigation, (5) Sign in again button routes to /login?next=..., (6) Banner suppresses itself on /login route, (7) CRM 401s do not trigger the banner.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: AppRoutes.js line 53 was importing '@/pages/GymAxisLoginPage' instead of '@/pages/LoginRedirectPage' - this caused the ?next= parameter handling to be completely bypassed
SessionResumedBanner correctly listens for gymaxis:session-expired event and shows banner with data-testid='session-expired-banner'
Banner correctly suppresses itself on /login route (checks window.location.pathname === '/login')
LoginRedirectPage correctly reads ?next= parameter and redirects authenticated users to the specified path
LoginPage correctly reads ?next= parameter and navigates to it after successful login
Axios interceptor correctly skips /api/crm/ and /api/member/ endpoints from silent refresh logic
context_for_next_testing_agent: Silent JWT refresh and session-expired banner feature is fully working. The critical fix was changing the import in AppRoutes.js from GymAxisLoginPage to LoginRedirectPage. All ?next= parameter flows work correctly for both authenticated and unauthenticated users. The banner correctly appears on non-login routes when gymaxis:session-expired event is dispatched, and suppresses itself on /login. CRM has its own auth handling and is correctly excluded from the interceptor.
